days.title: History and Information Hub
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Skaftafell Besucherzentrum
stops.detail: Open year-round, the Skaftafell Visitor Centre manages the southern area of the Vatnajökull National Park and offers park visitors information about the park, its surroundings, existing hiking trails, its nature and history, as well as further leisure opportunities and offers.

stops.name: Gömlutún
stops.detail: In earlier centuries, the Skaftafell farmstead stood directly at the foot of the mountains; in Gömlutún, some ruins can still be visited today.

stops.name: Sel
stops.detail: Sel was restored by the National Museum and is open to visitors today.

stops.name: Kristínartindar
stops.detail: The national park is named after the mountain Skaftafell, an extinct and eroded volcano whose remains are represented by the Kristínartindar.

stops.name: Svartifoss
stops.detail: A famous waterfall is located in this national park: the Svartifoss.
